dispositions.topic_text: Whether backup cadence is exactly every 60 seconds or at least once per minute, and the resulting A21 security-review outcome
Secret length byte semantics, exact-versus-minimum distinction, and required boundary/distinctness tests
Canonical serialization and decoding of owner-session random bytes at HTTP boundaries
dispositions.reason: The session identity, CSRF and confirmation values are issued and read back by Registry alone: no other party decodes them. A13 rule 7 fixes what matters — SECRET_MIN_BYTES random bytes, constant-time comparison, never in a URL, a log, a diagnostic or an audit entry — and the note of make_secret_value fixes a text form a cookie value and an HTML form field carry without escaping. Every such encoding keeps those guarantees, so the choice among them is the implementation's.
